title: Clopen basis of a profinite space
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological space. The open and closed subsets of $S$ form a basis of its topology: for every open $U\subseteq S$ and $s\in U$, there is an open and closed subset $V$ with $s\in V\subseteq U$.
